changes: 新增完整中英文界面，可通过主窗口“语言 / Language”选项即时切换；选择会保存并在下次启动时恢复。
快捷键编辑器、状态提示、冲突信息、关于窗口、版本历史和错误信息均支持中英文。
新增单实例保护：重复启动不会注册第二套快捷键，而是直接激活已经运行的窗口。
新增配置自动备份与恢复：每次保存前保留旧配置，默认最多保留20份，可从软件内恢复最近备份。
新增配置导入和导出，方便备份、迁移到新电脑或在其他目录复用快捷键设置。
配置格式升级为V5；V4及更早配置会自动迁移，原有快捷键和作者信息不丢失。
主窗口增加“配置管理”菜单和语言选择框，并适配中英文长度及不同DPI布局。
主窗口新增“使用指南”按钮，内置可离线打开、可打印的中英文图形用户指南。
扩充中英文资源、配置存储、单实例、V5迁移、双语启动和发布包自动测试。
changesEn: Added a complete Chinese/English interface with an immediate language selector in the main window; the choice is saved and restored on the next launch.
The shortcut editor, status messages, conflict details, About window, version history, and error messages now support both languages.
Added single-instance protection: launching the app again activates the existing window instead of registering a second set of hotkeys.
Added automatic configuration backup and recovery: the previous configuration is saved before each write, up to 20 backups are retained, and the latest backup can be restored in-app.
Added configuration import and export for backups, moving to another computer, or reusing shortcut settings elsewhere.
Upgraded the configuration format to V5. V4 and older configurations migrate automatically without losing existing shortcuts or author information.
Added a Config Tools menu and language selector to the main window, with layouts tested for both languages and multiple DPI settings.
Added a User Guide button that opens a bundled, printable, bilingual visual guide without network access.
Expanded automated tests for bilingual resources, configuration storage, single-instance behavior, V5 migration, bilingual startup, and release contents.

changes: 道路置平、表面置平、指定置平和补洞的快捷键改为各自独立保存，修改一个面板不会影响其他面板。
不同面板可以分别使用同一快捷键；同一面板内部重复以及全局备份重复仍会被阻止。
旧V1.1共享快捷键配置自动迁移到四个独立面板，原有键盘和鼠标绑定不丢失。
启动器优先使用Windows PowerShell 5.1，并在创建窗口前启用PerMonitorV2，修复跨不同缩放比显示器拖动时控件不重排、底部按钮被裁切的问题。
增加跨显示器DPI变化处理，主窗口、快捷键编辑器、关于窗口和提示窗口会自动限制在当前工作区内。
面板按钮按实际窗口宽高缩放；宽高比例严重失真时拒绝点击，避免高DPI下误点。
修复Windows PowerShell 5.1严格模式下空快捷键冲突列表导致的“找不到属性Count”启动错误。
扩充独立面板、配置迁移、DPI和分辨率自动测试。
changesEn: Shortcuts for Road Leveling, Surface Leveling, Specified Leveling, and Hole Patching are stored independently, so changing one panel does not affect the others.
Different panels may reuse the same shortcut; duplicates within one panel and conflicts with the global backup shortcut are still blocked.
Legacy V1.1 shared bindings migrate automatically to the four independent panels without losing keyboard or mouse bindings.
Added support for 100%, 125%, 150%, 175%, 200%, and 250% scaling, plus 1080p, 1440p, 4K, and ultrawide layouts.
The launcher now prefers Windows PowerShell 5.1 and enables PerMonitorV2 before creating windows, fixing clipped controls and bottom buttons when moving across displays with different scale factors.
Added cross-monitor DPI handling so the main window, shortcut editor, About window, and prompt windows stay inside the current work area.
Panel buttons follow the actual panel width and height; severe aspect-ratio distortion blocks clicks to prevent high-DPI misclicks.
Fixed the startup error that reported a missing Count property when Windows PowerShell 5.1 processed an empty shortcut conflict list under strict mode.
Expanded automated tests for independent panels, configuration migration, DPI, and resolution handling.

changes: 新增通用备份快捷键，自动执行“打开备份窗口→全选→立即备份”。
新增快捷键可视化编辑、重复检测和模方原版快捷键冲突提示。
新增全部快捷键恢复默认。
新增道路置平、表面置平、指定置平和补洞的自动识别。
模拟点击后恢复鼠标原位置，并缩短点击占用时间。
界面改为随窗口自适应，修复文字放大和遮挡；新增版本与版权说明。
修复快捷键消息回调、管理员权限和冲突列表崩溃问题。
改用GPL-3.0完全开源，允许研究、修改、再分发和商业使用，同时要求衍生发行继续开源并保留作者署名。
changesEn: Added a global backup shortcut that runs Open Backup, Select All, and Backup Now.
Added visual shortcut editing, duplicate detection, and warnings for conflicts with original ModelFun shortcuts.
Added one-click restoration of all default shortcuts.
Added automatic detection for Road Leveling, Surface Leveling, Specified Leveling, and Hole Patching.
Restored the mouse position after simulated clicks and reduced click occupancy time.
Made the interface adapt to window size, fixed enlarged or overlapping text, and added version and copyright information.
Fixed shortcut message callbacks, administrator permission handling, and conflict-list crashes.

Switched to fully open-source GPL-3.0 licensing, allowing research, modification, redistribution, and commercial use while requiring derivative distributions to remain open source and keep author credit.

changes: 实现道路置平、表面置平、指定置平和补洞的自动识别。
实现四个模方面板按钮的快捷键映射。
支持键盘快捷键与鼠标侧键。
增加管理员权限运行和鼠标点击恢复。
修复热键回调与面板识别链路。
changesEn: Implemented automatic detection for Road Leveling, Surface Leveling, Specified Leveling, and Hole Patching.
Implemented shortcut mappings for buttons in all four ModelFun panels.
Added keyboard shortcuts and mouse side-button support.
Added administrator-level execution and mouse-position restoration.
Fixed the hotkey callback and panel-detection chain.

changes: 原始原型版本。
仅支持单个面板，并通过手动两点校准定位按钮。
changesEn: Original prototype version.
Supported only one panel and used manual two-point calibration to locate buttons.
